description: Get one issue. Slim nested milestone by default; full_response=true for the complete milestone. Use this for issue management. Use `list_issues` or `my_issues` to discover issues first.

full_response.description: If true, include the complete milestone (including description). Default is slim (id, iid, title, state, web_url).

jmespath.description: Optional JMESPath expression filtering the JSON result before return.

name: get_issue
